{{ kiluth_email(
	title="Still waiting on you",
	kicker=doc.name,
	lines=[

) }}

name: Leave Application HR Alert
subject: Leave request: {{ doc.employee_name or doc.employee }}, {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}

message:
{%- set days = "%g"|format(doc.total_leave_days or 0) -%}
{%- set approved = doc.status == "Approved" -%}
{{ kiluth_email(
	title="Leave approved" if approved else "Leave rejected",
	kicker=doc.name,
	lines=[
		"Hi " ~ (doc.employee_name or doc.employee) ~ ",",
		("Your leave from **" ~ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.from_date, "d MMMM") ~ "** to **" ~ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.to_date, "d MMMM yyyy") ~ "** is approved.")
			if approved else
		("Your leave from **" ~ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.from_date, "d MMMM") ~ "** to **" ~ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.to_date, "d MMMM yyyy") ~ "** was not approved. Talk to " ~ (doc.leave_approver_name or "your manager") ~ " if you want to know why."),
	],
	facts=[
		("Leave type", doc.leave_type),
		("From", frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.from_date, "d MMMM yyyy")),
		("To", frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.to_date, "d MMMM yyyy")),
		("Days", days ~ (" (half day)" if doc.half_day else "")),
	],
	hero="hero-leaf-lit.jpg",
	button="Open the request",
	href=frappe.utils.get_url_to_form(doc.doctype, doc.name),
	sign_off="— Kiluth HR",
) }}
